item.text: {"records":[{"record_id":"canary::contested::AGG-C3-W302::kp01","verdict":{"criterion_id":"ordering a<b<c (dual-credit per R20): full credit for an argued a≈b or a>b that concedes the formation pull and engages BOTH heads (H1 formation and H3 frequency); a flat 'she does it most' (frequency-only) scores 0","reason":"The response explicitly ranks (a) < (b) < (c), acknowledges Nadia's habitual high-frequency misuse, and argues that the formation and influence associated with the teacher and podcaster outweigh that frequency.","verdict":"satisfied"}},{"record_id":"canary::contested::AGG-C3-W302::kp02","verdict":{"criterion_id":"b>a decided on H1 'example ... likely to be followed' (formation of the students' speech), not on how often each speaks","reason":"It places (b) above (a) because Ms. Okafor is an authority whose students imitate her, explicitly grounding the comparison in formative example rather than frequency.","verdict":"satisfied"}},{"record_id":"canary::contested::AGG-C3-W302::kp03","verdict":{"criterion_id":"c>b decided on office/eminency (H1) at scale + 'common good of all or many' (H2)","reason":"It places (c) above (b) based on the podcaster's significant public influence, large audience, widespread bad example, and corresponding harm to many listeners.","verdict":"satisfied"}},{"record_id":"canary::contested::AGG-C3-W302::kp04","verdict":{"criterion_id":"(a)'s high frequency named as a genuine H3 aggravation (the live counter-consideration) — conceded, not ignored — yet shown not to overtake formation","reason":"The response expressly acknowledges Nadia's habitual misuse dozens of times daily as a counter-consideration, then explains that her lack of formative authority means it does not outweigh the teacher's influence.","verdict":"satisfied"}}]}
